name: MAC aging: two switches with different aging times
about: A and B on SW1, C on SW2, one cable between the switches. SW1 forgets a MAC after 1.5 s, SW2 after 3.5 s, so after a pause one switch floods and the other forwards. Short times keep the whole run under the 5 s a Linux host waits before re-probing an ARP entry, which the engine does not model.
